organ_1.mp3.name: organ
organ_1.mp3.prompt: Solo pipe organ in a vast, reverberant iron chamber, a short eerie baroque toccata phrase in D minor: a dramatic opening flourish with a mordent and a fast descending run in octaves, answered an octave lower, then a thundering low pedal note under a dark diminished chord that swells and rings out. Ominous, gothic, played by a lone organist deep under the sea. Organ only: no drums, no orchestra, no choir, no vocals.
